how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form in person from the Cash Department (Room No. 15) of Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital between 07.10.2026 and 16.10.2026 (11:00 AM to 03:30 PM) upon paying the fee of Rs. 1,026/-.
Fill out the application form completely with your home address, pin code, mobile number, and email ID.
Attach attested photocopies of educational qualifications and recent passport-size photographs affixed to the application form.
Attach the original fee payment receipt to the application form.
Submit the completed application form along with enclosures to the Inward-Outward Department of Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital by 16.10.2026 up to 04:00 PM.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely on a contractual basis up to 31.03.2027 (with a 1-day break every 90 days) or until a regular candidate is appointed, whichever is earlier. Selected candidates must execute a contract agreement on a Rs. 500/- bond paper at their own expense. Biometric attendance is mandatory for contractual employees. Selected candidates must submit a character certificate from the respective police station within one month of appointment showing no criminal record. Selected candidates who wish to resign must give a 30-day prior notice. The administration reserves the right to cancel appointments without prior notice or terminate services if work is unsatisfactory.

content_sections.heading: BMC FNB Teacher Recruitment Vacancy Details (Post-wise)

content_sections.heading: BMC FNB Teacher Recruitment Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Additional mandatory educational qualifications for all posts: Must have completed qualification as per National Medical Commission (NMC) notification dated 30.06.2025, and attach all required educational mark sheets and certificates. Must have passed secondary or higher secondary school examination from Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education or equivalent with Marathi as a subject carrying at least 50 marks in the question paper. Must have passed CCC computer examination conducted by DOEACC Society, or MS-CIT / GECT certificate issued by Directorate of Higher and Technical Education, Mumbai, Maharashtra State. Must be registered with the Maharashtra Medical Council.

rows.post: FNB Teacher Grade-1 (Senior Consultant) Paediatric Hemato-Oncology
rows.qualification_required: DM/DNB or equivalent postgraduate degree in the concerned subject, followed by at least 8 years of actual working experience in the relevant department after the postgraduate degree.

rows.post: FNB Teacher Grade-2 (Junior Consultant) Paediatric Hemato-Oncology
rows.qualification_required: DM/DNB or equivalent postgraduate degree in the concerned subject, followed by at least 5 years of actual working experience in the relevant department after the postgraduate degree.

content_sections.heading: BMC FNB Teacher Recruitment Age Limit
content_sections.text: For general category candidates, the age should not exceed 55 years .

content_sections.heading: BMC FNB Teacher Recruitment Salary
content_sections.text: Contractual employees are not entitled to any dearness allowance, house rent allowance, or other allowances. No pension scheme, provident fund scheme, or Mumbai Municipal Corporation (Service) Rules 1989 will apply after appointment.

content_sections.heading: BMC FNB Teacher Recruitment Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid in cash at the cash counter (Room No. 15) of Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital. The fee receipt must be attached with the application form.

content_sections.heading: BMC Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection will be made based on the prescribed educational qualification and marks obtained through the interview process, resulting in the preparation of a merit list and selection list. Walk-in Interview Details: Date: 19.10.2026 in the Dean's Conference Hall, College Building, Ground Floor, Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital and Medical College, Sion, Mumbai – 400022.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BMC Recruitment
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form in person from the Cash Department (Room No. 15) of Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital between 07.10.2026 and 16.10.2026 (11:00 AM to 03:30 PM) upon paying the fee of Rs. 1,026/-. Fill out the application form completely with your home address, pin code, mobile number, and email ID. Attach attested photocopies of educational qualifications and recent passport-size photographs affixed to the application form. Attach the original fee payment receipt to the application form. Submit the completed application form along with enclosures to the Inward-Outward Department of Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital by 16.10.2026 up to 04:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Attested photocopies of educational degree certificates and mark sheets NMC registration certificate / Maharashtra Medical Council registration certificate Marathi subject passing certificate (Class 10 or 12 board mark sheet) CCC / MS-CIT / GECT computer certificate Experience certificates Marriage registration certificate or gazette notification for name change (if applicable) No Objection Certificate from current employer (if employed) Fee payment receipt

content_sections.heading: BMC Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on a contractual basis up to 31.03.2027 (with a 1-day break every 90 days) or until a regular candidate is appointed, whichever is earlier. Selected candidates must execute a contract agreement on a Rs. 500/- bond paper at their own expense. Biometric attendance is mandatory for contractual employees. Selected candidates must submit a character certificate from the respective police station within one month of appointment showing no criminal record. Selected candidates who wish to resign must give a 30-day prior notice. The administration reserves the right to cancel appointments without prior notice or terminate services if work is unsatisfactory.

faq.question: Q1. What is BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BMC Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment drive by Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation to fill 2 contractual FNB Teacher Grade-1 and Grade-2 posts in Paediatric Hemato-Oncology at Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital and Medical College, Sion.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies are available: 1 for FNB Teacher Grade-1 (Senior Consultant) and 1 for FNB Teacher Grade-2 (Junior Consultant).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 16 October 2026 up to 04:00 PM at the Inward-Outward Department of LTMG Hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for FNB Teacher Grade-1?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a DM/DNB or equivalent postgraduate degree in the concerned subject with at least 8 years of actual working experience after the postgraduate degree, along with mandatory Marathi and computer knowledge certificates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for BMC FNB Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for general category candidates is 55 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 869/- plus 18% GST (Rs. 157/-), making a total of Rs. 1,026/- payable in cash at the hospital cash counter.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for BMC FNB Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must purchase the prescribed application form from Room No. 15 of LTMG Hospital, fill it out, attach required documents and fee receipt, and submit it in person at the hospital's Inward-Outward Department.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BMC recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection is based on the prescribed educational qualifications and performance in the walk-in interview scheduled for 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: FNB Teacher Grade-1 receives a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 2,00,000/-, and FNB Teacher Grade-2 receives Rs. 1,50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a purely contractual appointment valid up to 31 March 2027 or until regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier.
